classification_reason: The validator catches and names cases a, b and d precisely, and the binary capture (c) is handled safely. But two schema-valid inputs certified clean by `make check` take the whole product down: the documented supersession (f) and a unit without the optional scope_sources (e). Both fail the published-manifest contract, and the error prescribes a developer contract bump. Parse or projection failures during a write are misreported as retryable INTERNAL_FAILURE and leave orphan crash journals.

consumer.goal: Introduce six kinds of malformed or edge input one at a time on a fresh world and record which command catches each and whether the rest keeps working
consumer.first_action: read system/schema/unit.schema.json, note.schema.json, workspace.schema.json required fields and VALIDATION.md rules
commands: per case (after git reset --hard + git clean -fdx -e .venv): mutation; tools/validate.py --compact --no-report; los generate; los search TERM; los search TERM --type note --content; los bootstrap --brief; los status; make check
extra: inspect, note-read, related, resume, intelligence-scan, operations under case a
capture.create attempts under cases a, b, e2, f2; exact retries under case a before and after the fix
second same-basename binary capture under case c
minimizations e2 (drop scope_sources) and f2 (one supersedes line)
confusions: read failures in case a say 'cannot publish the manifest' although the command was a search
cases e and f print instructions for maintainers (bump manifest contract, edit the UI repository) to a consumer
status prints 'validation: 1 error(s) · N warning(s), visible and nonblocking', which reads as if the error were nonblocking too
intelligence-scan --brief returns an empty result on the clean world too, so it gives no signal either way
corrective_steps: fixed case a by `git checkout` of the note, then `los generate` to clear the journal
consumer.outcome: Typos in fields the validator knows are caught with the file named. Two edits the validator calls clean (a documented supersession; a unit without an optional field) make search, inspect, bootstrap and every write fail with an instruction to change the product's interface contract.

internal.transaction_behavior: case b: whole-repository shadow validation refuses cleanly (VALIDATION_FAILED, no journal); cases a/e2/f2: INTERNAL_FAILURE after canonical rollback with 'rollback incomplete for: <projection publication>' and an orphan .inflight/<txn>/intent.json whose paths are already back to 'before'
internal.approval_behavior: all envelopes sealed with intent_sha256; approval never the refusal cause
internal.projection_activity: generate refused in a, e, e2, f, f2 (contract enforcement on the producer)
unexpected_writes: orphan .inflight journals after non-crash refusals (a, e2, f2)
warnings_errors: manifest contract v15 violations (e, e2, f, f2)
internal.git_diff_stat: per-case; final world state = case f2 (note-lsm-trees +1 line) with one orphan journal

friction.description: manifest-contract errors tell a consumer to bump the contract and edit the UI repository instead of naming the offending record file
INTERNAL_FAILURE retryable:true with 'rollback incomplete' after a clean refusal suggests possible corruption
friction.cost: 4 tool calls to establish canonical state was restored
